mapper.select: SELECT t.public_id,t.status, CASE WHEN r.status='SUCCEEDED' THEN '退款已完成' WHEN r.status='FAILED' THEN '渠道确认退款失败，等待处理' WHEN d.state IN ('READY','WAITING') THEN '正在重新核验渠道' WHEN t.status='OPEN' THEN '等待人工核验' ELSE '人工处理中，退款结果仍待核实' END AS progress, t.customer_message,GREATEST(t.updated_at,r.updated_at,d.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM refund_request r JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=r.order_id JOIN refund_delivery d ON d.refund_id=r.id JOIN ticket t ON t.source_action_id=#{actionId} AND t.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE r.id=#{refundId} AND o.customer_id=#{customerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_delivery(refund_id,attempt_no,deadline_at) SELECT id,attempt_no,DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) FROM refund_request WHERE public_id=#{publicId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempt_no=VALUES(attempt_no),state='READY',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL, next_run_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),next_publish_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),deadline_at=VALUES(deadline_at),last_error=NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM refund_request r JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE r.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_request SET failure_reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM refund_request r JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE r.public_id=#{publicId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM refund_request r JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE r.public_id=#{publicId}
SELECT FROM refund_request r JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE r.order_id=#{orderId}
SELECT FROM refund_request r JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=r.order_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT event_id,refund_id,attempt_no,outcome,amount,reason,disposition FROM refund_event WHERE event_id=#{eventId} FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_request SET status=#{outcome},failure_reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo}
UPDATE refund_request SET status='PROCESSING',attempt_no=attempt_no+1,failure_reason=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED' AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo}
UPDATE payment SET refund_status=#{target} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status='PAID' AND refund_status=#{expected}
